description: Check a data module against BREX rules and report violations with location (XPath + line), actual value, rule id, objectUse text and severity. Also accepts a publication module (pm) or a comment (the brexDmRef in pmStatus / commentStatus is followed). By default follows the document's brexDmRef chain (project BREX → … → S1000D default BREX found under S1000D_SPEC_DIR) and checks each layer separately; pass "brex" to check against one specific BREX instead or in addition. Does NOT validate against the XML schema (XSD): run schema validation separately. nonContextRules cannot be checked automatically and are returned as manualChecks.

brex.description: A specific BREX (file path or DMC) to check against. With followChain=false it is the only layer; otherwise it is added to the chain.

csdbDirs.description: CSDB folders to search for BREX by DMC (default: S1000D_CSDB_DIR / the config file; S1000D_SPEC_DIR is always searched for the S1000D default BREX). When given, these folders replace S1000D_CSDB_DIR and the csdbDirs of the config file (they are not added to them); folders that do not exist are skipped and reported in _notes.

followChain.description: Follow the brexDmRef chain of the data module (default true).

includeManualChecks.description: Include nonContextRules as manualChecks in each layer (default true).

maxViolationsPerLayer.description: Cap on violations returned per layer (default 200). The total count is always reported.

path.description: File path of the data module to check.

xml.description: The data module as an XML string (alternative to path; max 5 MB).

name: check_against_brex
